newsitem.title: UK: UK's OFT to review London bid until Jan 20.
newsitem.headline: UK's OFT to review London bid until Jan 20.

text.p: Britain's Office of Fair Trading will consider the agreed bid for regional electricity company (Rec) London Electricity from U.S.-based Entergy Corp until January 20, a statement from the OFT said.
The 1.267 billion stg bid was launched on December 18 with a recommendation from London Electricity's board.
The OFT advises the trade and industry secretary Ian Lang on whether bids should be referred to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC).

The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) has already cleared two other current bids for regional electricity companies from U.S. companies, that of Dominion Resources for East Midlands Electricity and by CE Electric, which is 70 percent owned by CalEnergy, for Northern.
